sequence: All seven sheets were generated, visually inspected and saved before variant mesh authoring began.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game-prop technical reference sheet for Qingxi village water report family, C03_tall_01. Primary request: ONE tall water bucket, 0.32m body diameter and 0.42m body height: straight-sided 16 timber staves, inset circular bottom foot, thick rolled wood rim, two small horizontal side grip cleats; NO arched bail handle. Two bronze carrying eyes at X=-0.16 and +0.16m, Z=0.30m, centered on the sides. This tall cylindrical body must differ in construction from a squat octagonal tub and a curved handled pail. Show EXACTLY THREE complete orthographic views of this SAME single prop: FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, BACK, left-to-right with labels and the ID C03_tall_01. Keep construction and proportions identical between views. Show the open interior from a very small technical top inset only if needed, but the three main views must be orthographic. Warm weathered wood, aged bamboo, hemp and restrained aged bronze, lightly stylized Chinese rural cultivation village. Ground is Z=0; front is -Y; shared carrying eye pair and ground origin are the interface. Warm ivory technical background, soft even studio light, readable worn joinery, no scenery, people, extra props or logos. Empty bucket only; water fill is a separate state, not a shape variant. Clear geometry for subsequent modeling, no perspective view. Text only ID and FRONT / RIGHT SIDE / BACK and a few dimensions.
assets.review: Accepted three consistent views. Render is slightly elevated; use .32m body diameter and .42m height, shared lift anchors x=+/- .16,z=.30.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original technical game prop reference C06_fork_01 for Qingxi rural Chinese cultivation village. ONE freestanding construction cloth flag. Shared frame: warm gray stone socket 0.24m wide x 0.22m deep, bamboo mast to 0.85m high, crossbeam 0.46m wide at Z=0.79m; three hemp tie positions X=-0.16,0,+0.16m. Cloth width 0.36m, top Z=0.75m, bottom tails Z=0.30m with a deep central inverted-V NOTCH rising to Z=0.46m: two long triangular swallowtail points, clearly visible flat silhouette. Ochre cloth with a simple incomplete circle and two short strips as work-in-progress pattern; pattern is only a state and must not change the cut. Back has same cut, plain cloth. Produce one sheet with THREE complete consistent orthographic views FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, BACK, labelled with C06_fork_01. assets.review: Accepted V-cut twin tails and frame. AI dimension .22 near base is depth, not base height. Enforce .24x.22x.09 base, .85 total height, central shared mast and .46 crossbeam.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original technical game prop three-view reference C05_notch_01, Qingxi Chinese rural cultivation village. ONE soil-moisture wooden marker, NOT a water-level ruler. 0.30m wide irregular vertical wood plaque from Z=.28 to .70m, front has three small inset soil-color discs and a small rectangular swappable moisture patch, no letters or numeric scale. Clearly asymmetric timber edge: one broken top-right corner and a notch midway on left edge. One SQUARE central post, 0.040m x 0.040m, ground origin Z=0, buried tongue extends to Z=-0.12m. Above-ground rectangular stone foot collar 0.16m x 0.14m x 0.06m. Shared panel mount centered X=0,Z=.46m. Back has two horizontal wooden battens. This is one tall notched plank on a single straight square post. Show THREE complete consistent orthographic FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, BACK views of the SAME item, left-to-right with clear labels and ID C05_notch_01. Show ground line at Z=0 and buried tongue below it in all views, not cropped. Wood/stone construction matches every view. Warm old wood, muted earth colored insets, warm gray stone, soft even light, ivory background. No scenery, person, logos, extra props, perspective hero shot, measurement ticks on the prop, or leaderboard. Keep shape and ground socket interface clearly legible.
assets.review: Accepted irregular notched vertical plank and straight square post. Markers are soil status only. Enforce .30 width,.70 above ground; buried square tongue .04x.04 to -.12; same panel anchor z=.46 as fork.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original technical game prop three-view reference C05_fork_02, Qingxi Chinese rural cultivation village. assets.review: Accepted stepped two-board silhouette with Y-braces, differs structurally from notched plank. Central post can continue behind board as pictured; fork braces attach to two edges. Enforce .36 width and .62 above ground; same square ground socket.
